Kind Like My Melody (Korean: ) is Angel Chiffon Cookie's second Costume, released during the Camping with the Sanrio characters! update. It is a Rare Costume that can only be obtained by purchasing it with Acorn Medals in the Sanrio characters! Costume Shop.

Story

Angel Chiffon Cookie wears an adorable pink strawberry hood that looks just like My Melody Cookie's! She's busy baking a special almond pound cake for friends visiting the Cookie World. All her kindness and care will be baked right into the cake, making it extra soft and fluffy!

Trivia

  • Kind Like My Melody was released alongside  Raspberry Hood,  Sweet Cake Barista,  Sweet Cake Slice,  Fluffy Like Cinnamoroll,  Cozy Guide,  Tart Parfait Barista,  Tart Cherry Cream,  Unpredictable Like Kuromi,  Purrfect Prankster,  Blueberry Yogurt Barista,  Blueberry Yogurt Cream,  Soft Pudding Barista,  Spoonful of Pudding,  Carefree like Pompompurin,  Caramel Syrup Beret,  Energetic Banana Bread Barista,  Banana Bread Bonnet,  Playful Like Pochacco,  Lucky Charm,  Hard Working Shaved Ice Barista,  Spoonful of Shaved Ice,  Warm Like Hangyodon,  Fish Cake Ribbon.
  • Kind Like My Melody features Angel Chiffon Cookie dressed in an outfit themed after My Melody Cookie.

“ It tastes magical, like a fairy made it? Hehe... I wonder if it's listening. „

Strawberry Festival Mascot (Korean: 딸기 페스티벌의 요정, ttalgi peseutibeol-eul yojeong, "Strawberry Festival Fairy") is Angel Chiffon Cookie's first costume, released in the first half of The Great Pâtissier Battle update. It is a Super Epic Costume that can be obtained either by drawing it from the Costume Gacha or by purchasing it in the Rainbow Crystal Shop.

Story

Strawberries are in season, and every Cookie knows what that means—it's time for a strawberry festival! Angel Chiffon Cookie's strawberry cream cake is a huge hit, even among all the delicious strawberry desserts. Its simple exterior belies its undeniably delicious flavor, so flavorful, its(sic) almost as if a magic spell has been placed upon it... Nobody can deny Angel Chiffon Cookie's baking is truly magical!

Trivia

  • Strawberry Festival Mascot was released alongside  Soft Strawberry Rice Cake,  Performance from the Soul,  Conductor of Souls,  Fated Souls,  Grass Leaf Cafe and  Melon Bread Hat.
